name: flexible-mem3dg-boundary
title: Rung 3 · Flexible Mem3DG boundary
claim: OBSERVED: under actin pressure the vesicle inflates. That load is redistributed across filaments / relaxed off the rigid curve is NOT yet quantified — inflation alone is not ratchet success.
decision_figure: rigid-vs-flexible side-by-side curvature & deformation maps (identical camera and scale) with the undeformed reference overlaid, plus per-filament load redistribution
expected_pattern: membrane deforms; curvature redistributes load; mean per-tip contact force drops vs the rigid rung; volume ↑ ≥ 10%
acceptance_threshold: membrane_volume ratio ≥ 1.1 AND mean per-tip contact_force < rigid-movable baseline
question: With barrier_kind="flexible" (closed-icosphere Mem3DG mesh inside-pushed by bonded actin filaments), does the membrane deform under actin pressure and relax the contact-force burden compared to the rigid_movable rung?

purpose.question: With barrier_kind="flexible" (closed-icosphere Mem3DG mesh inside-pushed by bonded actin filaments), does the membrane deform under actin pressure and relax the contact-force burden compared to the rigid_movable rung?
purpose.mechanism: Spec §2.2 rung 3. The coupler runs full Mem3DG: actin tip positions raise contact_force on the inner surface; mem3dg integrates the resulting osmotic_offset; the vesicle inflates, distributing load across the mesh and shifting the F-V scatter point off the rigid-wall curve.
purpose.expected_outcome: Vesicle volume grows visibly (≥10%) over the run; mean barrier expansion rate is positive; F-V scatter lies clearly off the rung-2 line.

variants.name: soft-coupling
variants.description: Weak osmotic gain — membrane barely inflates, load stays on actin.

variants.name: stiff-coupling
variants.description: Strong osmotic gain — vesicle inflates fast, relaxing contact force.

tests.name: membrane-curvature-relaxes-load
tests.question: Membrane volume increases by ≥10% over the run (vesicle inflates under actin pressure) and final mean contact_force is below the rung-1 mean.

model_change.notes: Spec §2.2 rung 3 (Phase-2 endpoint). Closed Mem3DG icosphere vesicle inflates under actin contact force translated through osmotic_strength_offset.

simulation_set.name: rung3-flexible
simulation_set.description: Closed-loop coupled run: ReaDDy actin pushes against a Mem3DG icosphere; coupler publishes osmotic_offset every step.

mechanism_uncertainty_addressed: Does a deformable membrane redistribute actin load and relax contact force off the rigid curve?
resolved_uncertainties: Under actin pressure the vesicle inflates (OBSERVED).
remaining_uncertainties: Load redistribution across filaments and relaxation of per-tip contact force vs the rigid rung are not yet quantified — inflation alone is not ratchet success.

alternate_hypotheses.statement: Vesicle inflation is driven by the osmotic setpoint itself, not by actin pushing — the membrane would inflate without the actin field.
evidence_against: per-tip contact force dropping below the rigid baseline, and curvature concentrating at the contact zone, would indicate genuine load redistribution.
discriminating_observables: mean per-tip contact_force vs rigid rung
curvature map at the contact zone

mechanism_update_proposals.statement: Supports a deformable barrier that stores/redistributes load, distinct from the rigid rungs.

followup_study_proposals.title: Rigid-vs-flexible per-tip contact-force comparison + curvature maps (identical camera/scale)
followup_study_proposals.expected_information_gain: Tests whether the membrane actually relaxes load off the rigid curve.
